app.name: Galmee Pharmacy
app.tagline: See which drugs expire next month and how much money is sitting in them.

common.offlineBody: Galmee will reconnect automatically. Sales you make offline will sync when the internet is back.
common.notFoundBody: This page does not exist or is not part of your pharmacy.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email and open the link to confirm your account, then log in.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errorPassword: Password must be at least 10 characters.

onboarding.intro: One last step: tell us about your pharmacy.
onboarding.error: Could not create the pharmacy. Please try again.
onboarding.errorPhone: Enter an Ethiopian phone number, for example 0911 234 567.
